source: Curated observations from the private Dynamo difficulty-methods ledger
selection: Four documented local redesign comparisons selected to contrast methods that remained easy with methods that reduced observed solves. Not a complete inventory or controlled experiment.
limitations: Task revisions changed more than one factor; differences do not establish a causal effect.
Local historical probes have different sample sizes and are not pooled with official evaluations.
Small samples and changing tasks cannot support a general model ranking.

rows.label: Finite rule enumeration
rows.change: Add a distinction between proof and property roles.
rows.interpretation: Still easy: a fully specified bounded search remained directly implementable.

rows.label: Named convention profiles
rows.change: Add scope-specific revision ordering to an archive-local profile task.
rows.interpretation: Still easy: fresh agents implemented the finite profile space even when old solutions failed.

rows.label: Competing evidence scopes
rows.change: Require separating target evidence from other valid evidence in the same environment.
rows.interpretation: Harder locally: plausible global processing violated an explicit scope boundary.

rows.label: Archive-specific inference
rows.change: Replace a single visible profile with evidence-based inference; use the later fairness-corrected probe.
rows.interpretation: Harder locally after removing an undisclosed tie-break. The fair revision is reported, not the earlier 0/10.
